import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Normalize category label variants to the allowed set
    cat_map = {
        'accessories': 'Accessories',
        'office supplies': 'Office Supplies',
        'Furnture': 'Furniture'
    }
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].replace(cat_map)
    # Coerce numeric columns just in case
    df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    g = df.dropna(subset=['Category', 'Price']).groupby('Category')['Price'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
